text:
Priya (sales): FinCorp just asked for a firm plan for a commit: ~2k qps peak chat + embeddings, bursty. They want reserved GPU recommendation, autoscale behavior, and answers for the security questionnaire.
Liam (solutions): Do we have their spike cadence? steady vs unpredictable?
FinCorp PM: Baseline ~80 rps, spikes to ~2000 qps for 10-20m, 3-4x/week, often predictable around business hours.
Vera (eng-infra): Quick calc: model profile (redwood-llama-8b-q) -> one standard node ~300-350 qps for chat. So target 2000 -> reserve 6-7 nodes to cover peak headroom. Recommend 7 reserved for 20% buffer.
Liam (solutions): Sales wants pricing variants: full reserve vs partial reserve + burst credits vs autoscale-only.
Vera (eng-infra): Options: A) 7 reserved nodes (predictable cost, lowest tail latency). B) 3 reserved + autoscale to 10 max (lower commit, some coldstart risk). C) autoscale-only (no commit). I'll provide numbers based on perf sim.
Diego (sre): Note coldstart: model init + KV warmup can add 1-30s tail latency. Mitigations: scheduled prewarm, background KV warmers, lightweight fallback (quantized-4bit) for initial traffic.
Priya (sales): Can we give a prewarm recipe to include in the SOW?
Vera (eng-infra): Yes. Example policy snippet:
```
autoscale:
  min: 3
  max: 10
  rps_target_per_replica: 120
  cooldown_s: 60
  prewarm_cmd: /ops/prewarm --model=redwood-llama-8b-q --prefixes=top1000 --threads=6 --duration=300
```
Prewarm one-liner:
```
./prewarm --model redwood-llama-8b-q --prefix-file prefixes.txt --parallel 6 --duration 300
```
Diego (sre): Also include health-fallback: on repeated start failures swap to smaller quantized variant in same AZ and alert on escalation.
Priya (sales): Pricing math pleaseclient wants monthly committed cost vs expected burst spend.
Vera (eng-infra): Rough sim: extra node ~0.12$/min. 15m spike with +4 nodes -> ~7.2$ per spike. At 12 spikes/mo -> ~86$/mo. At 60 spikes/mo -> ~432$/mo. Reserved node monthly rates x7 = committed base. I'll attach detailed sim CSV.
Noemi (security): Dedicated meets KMS per-tenant and VPC peering. Audit logs retention 90d standard, expand via add-on. I'll fill questionnaire: SOC2 mapping, KMS rotation, network egress rules.
FinCorp PM: We require AZ spread and fallback model acceptance in contract. Also need a signed traffic trace.
Liam (solutions): Action items: Vera run perf sim + pricing, Diego draft prewarm + fallback runbook, Noemi complete questionnaire, Priya update SOW with AZ spread and fallback clause.
ops-bot: perf-sim job 1712345740 completed (status: success)
Vera (eng-infra): Uploaded sim summary: Option A (7 reserved) = $XX,XXX/mo, median latency 110ms, p99 380ms. Option B (3 reserved + autoscale) = $YY,YYY/mo + ~$432/mo sample burst, median 150ms, p99 720ms. Option C (autoscale-only) = $ZZ,ZZZ/mo, median 210ms, p99 1.6s. Full CSV in drive.
Priya (sales): Great. I'll prepare the customer slide and attach security answers. Setting status -> waiting_on_customer until we get signed schedule + traffic logs.
FinCorp PM: Thanks all, will review and reply with signed schedule next week.
